info.title: Lantern API
info.description: Lantern: live food, mental-health and community support resources for Northern Virginia — public search, provider portal, community reports, and a verification API.

post.description: Anonymous community report. Nothing identifying is stored; the IP is used only for in-memory rate limiting.
Natural-language search -> filters. Only the typed words are sent to the AI service (never location/account).

get.description: Distribution windows (recurring + one-time events) in the next `days` days, soonest first.

post.description: Begin sign-in with the configured OpenID Connect provider. The browser then goes to the returned URL.

Ask Claude to structure the free-text hours/eligibility kept from source records. Results become pending
change proposals (origin=ai) — each schedule/requirement backed by a verbatim quote — for a reviewer to accept.

ChangeRequestIn.title: ChangeRequestIn
ChangeRequestIn.description: Pantry-proposed corrections. They enter the review queue as change proposals (origin=provider).

ResourceEditIn.title: ResourceEditIn
ResourceEditIn.description: Partial edit. Nested lists (services/schedules/eligibility), when present, replace the existing set.
